facts.fact: 她从头皮拔下一根头发，夹进日记的中缝——当作「动力」。
facts.anchor: yanks a strand of hair from her scalp. Placing it on the page in front of her, she decides to use it as motivation, tucking it inside the middle crease.

facts.fact: 曾经的「金色王冠」已成贴耳的黑色齐发——脸颊凹陷、面色惨白，镜中是骷髅。
facts.anchor: Such a stark contrast to the jet-black, blunt bob now tucked behind small ears on a hollowing and pale face.

facts.fact: 她用厨房剪刀剪掉长发——抹掉最后一点身份；这是她至今最冒险的一步。
facts.anchor: It was a bittersweet victory when she took the plunge, removing the last of her identity by taking the kitchen scissors to the side of her neck and starting to chop.

facts.fact: 反抗的火苗被一只拳头掐灭——他一把攥住她的后脑。
facts.anchor: She was right to give her hair a funeral, because the flames didn’t last long, snuffed out completely the minute he grabbed the back of her head with a clenched fist.

facts.fact: 升级路线：恶语→惩罚威胁→遍身紫青的淤伤。
facts.anchor: It started with cruel words, escalated to threats of punishment, and now she’s reached the point of purple bruises embroidered across her body.

facts.fact: 他的最后通牒：再逼我一次——你会带着悔恨躺进六英尺下的泥土里。
facts.anchor: ‘You’ll be haunted with regret, mourning the consequences of your own actions while you’re six feet under, buried in the dirt.’
